_description: Request body for POST /api/model/train — triggers a manual model training run. An empty body is also accepted; all fields have defaults.

_constraints.forceRetrain: Optional. Boolean. Default: false. If true, bypasses the minimum sample threshold (active-learning.min-training-samples). Use with caution on small datasets.
_constraints.note: Optional. Free-text audit note. Logged alongside the training run, not persisted to the database.

_variant_normal._comment: Standard training run — respects the minimum sample threshold.
_variant_normal.note: Manual retrain after bulk seed data import.

_variant_force._comment: Force retrain — bypasses minimum threshold. Useful for development with small datasets.
_variant_force.note: Force retrain for development testing with limited seed data.

_variant_empty_body._comment: An empty body is also valid. Both fields default: forceRetrain=false, note=null.

note: Manual retrain after bulk seed data import.
